description: Describes the five screening games on dyscalculia.io: what each measures, how many items it has, what an item is and how items and games are scored in general terms, and the limits. Optionally returns the item sets (dot counts, number pairs, number-line targets, digit-sequence lengths). It describes the test only: it does not score anyone, take answers or return a result. The test is a screening of basic number skills, not a diagnosis.

game.description: One game key: dotEnumeration, symbolicCompare, nonSymbolicCompare, numberLine, digitSpan.

include_items.description: Include the item sets. Default false.

name: explain_screening_test
title: Explain the free number-skills screening test
